m: 1. मथ् or मन्थ् (q.v.) cl. 1. 9. P. (Dhātup. xx, 18; iii, 5 and xxxi, 40) मथति, मन्थति, मथ्नाति (Ved. and ep. also Ā. मथते, मन्थते and मथ्नीते; Impv. मथ्नध्वम्, MBh.; pf. ममाथ, AV.; 3. pl. ममथुः, Vop.; मेथुः, मेथिरे, Br.; ममन्थ, ˚न्थुः, MBh.; aor. मथीत्, RV.; अमन्थिष्टाम्, ib.; अमथिषत, Br.; fut. मथिष्यति, ˚ते; मन्थिष्यति, Br. &c.; मथिता, MBh.; inf. मथितुम्, MBh. &c.; ˚तोस्, Br.; मन्थितवै, MaitrS.; ind.p. मथित्वा, -मथ्य, Br. &c.; मन्थित्वा, Pāṇ. i, 2, 33; -मन्थ्य and -माथम्, MBh. &c.), to stir or whirl round, RV. &c. &c.; (with अग्निम्), to produce fire by rapidly whirling round or rotating a dry stick (अरणि) in another dry stick prepared to receive it, ib.; (with अरणिम्), to rotate the stick for producing fire, MBh.; Kāv.; Pur.; (with ऊरुम्, हस्तम् &c.), to use friction upon any part of the body with the object of producing offspring from it, Hariv.; BhP.; to churn (milk into butter), produce by churning, TS. &c. &c. (also with two acc., e.g. सुधां क्षीर-निधिम् मथ्नाति, ‘he churns nectar out of the ocean of milk’, Siddh. on Pāṇ. i, 4, 51); to mix, mingle, Suśr.; to stir up, shake, agitate, trouble disturb, afflict, distress, hurt, destroy, AV. &c. &c.: Pass. मथ्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to be stirred up or churned &c., RV. &c. &c.: Caus. मन्थयति (Lāṭy.), माथयति or मथयति (MBh.), to cause to be stirred up or churned &c.: Desid. मिमथिषति, मिमन्थिषति Gr.: Intens. मामथ्यते, मामन्त्ति &c., ib. [cf. Gk. μίνθη; Lat. mentha, menta; Lit. mentùrė; Germ. minza, Minze; Angl.Sax. minte; Eng. mint.]
2. मथ् mfn. (ifc.) destroying, a destroyer (cf. मधुमथ्)
मथ् m. See मथिन्.
मथा ind. a Nidhana formula, Lāṭy.
मथात See माथाथ.
मथाय Nom. P. ˚यति, to produce fire by friction, RV.; to tear off (a head), ib.; to shake, AV.
मथीन ˚नति (artificial Nom. fr. मथिन्), Siddh. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 13.

stirring or whirling round, churning or producing by churning, MBh.; R.; Pur.

a: मथन — a. (नी f.) [मथ् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] 1 Churning, stirring up. --2 Hurting, injuring. --3 Killing, destroying, a destroyer; मुग्धे मधुमथनमनुगतमनुसर राधिके Gīt. 2. --4 Rubbing. --नः N. of a tree (गणिकारिका, used in producing fire by attrition). --नं 1 Churning, stirring round, agitating. --2 Rubbing, friction. --3 Injury, hurting. destruction. --Comp. --अचलः, --पर्वतः the mountain Mandara used as a churning-stick.

[cf. पथिन् and Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83 &c.]; for मथीनाम् See मथि above) a churning-stick, any stick or staff for stirring or churning, RV. &c. &c.
the penis, L.
a thunderbolt, L.
wind, L.
a: मथिन् — m. [मथ्-इनि] (Nom. sing. मंथाः, acc. pl. मथः) 1 A churningstick; मुहुः प्रणुन्नेषु मथां विवतंनैर्नदस्सु कुंभेषु मृदंगमंथरं Ki. 4. 16; N. 22. 44. --2 Wind. --3 A thunderbolt. --4 The penis.

s: strI, (maTyate pAparASiryayA iti । maTa + “mandivASItyAdi .” uRA॰ । 1 । 39 । iti urac .) svanAmaKyAtapurI । aDunA AgarA iti KyAtasyAgravaRasya nagaram । (yaTA, raGO । 6 । 48 । “yasyAvaroDastanacandanAnAM prakzAlanAdvArivihArakAle । kalindakanyA maTurAM gatApi gaNgormmisaMsaktajaleva BAti ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । maDupaGnam 2 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ maDupurI 3 maDurA 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ sA ca mokzadAyakatIrTam । yaTA, -- “ayoDyA maTurA mAyA kASI kAYcI avantikA । purI dvAravatI cEva saptEtA mokzadAyikAH ॥ ayoDyA rAmanagarI maTurA kfzRapAlitA । etAstu pfTivImaDye na gaRyante kadAcana ॥ SrIrAmaDanuragrasTA ayoDyA sA mahApurI । maTurA keSavotsfzwasudarSanaviDAritA ॥” ityAdiBUtaSudDitantram ॥ * ॥ tatra vizRudarSanamAhAtmyaM yaTA, “yajjyEzWaSukladvAdaSyAM snAtvA vE yamunAjale । maTurAyAM hariM dfzwvA prApnoti paramAM gatim ॥ yamunAsalile snAtaH puruzo munisattama ! । jyezWAmUlAmale pakze dvAdaSyAmupavAsakft ॥ samaByarccyAcyutaM samyak maTurAyAM samAhitaH । aSvameDasya yajYasya prApnotyavikalaM Palam ॥ kaScidasmatkule jAtaH kAlindIsalilAplutaH । arccayizyati govindaM maTurAyAmupozitaH ॥ jyezWAmUlasite pakze yenEvaM vayamapyuta । parAmfdDimavApsyAmastAritAH sakulodBavEH ॥” iti vizRupurARe 6 aMSe 8 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ tasyA mAhAtmyaM yaTA, -- varAha uvAca । “na vidyate ca pAtAle nAntarIkze na mAnuze । samatvaM maTurAyA hi priyaM mama vasunDare ! ॥” sUta uvAca । “tacCrutvA vacanaM tasya praRamya SirasA tadA । puRyAnAM paramaM puRyaM pfTvI vacanamabravIt ॥ pfTivyuvAca । puzkaraM nEmizaM cEva purI vArARasI taTA । etA hitvA mahABAga ! maTurAM kiM praSaMsasi ॥ varAha uvAca । SfRu kArtsnena vasuDe ! kaTyamAnaM mayAnaDe ! । maTurati ca viKyAtaM nAsti kzetraM paraM mama । sA ramyA ca suSastA ca janmaBUmiH priyA mama ॥ SfRu devi ! yaTA stOmi maTurAM pApahAriRIm । tannivAsI naro yAti mokzaM nAstyatra saMSayaH ॥ mahAmADyAM prayAge tu yat PalaM laBate naraH । tat PalaM laBate devi ! maTurAyAM dine dine ॥ kArttikyAYcEva yat puRyaM puzkare tu vasunDare ! । tat PalaM laBate devi ! maTurAyAM dine dine ॥ pUrRe varzasahasre tu vArARasyAntu yat Palam । tat PalaM laBate devi ! maTurAyAM kzaRena hi ॥ maTurAYca parityajya yo'nyatra kurute ratim । mUQo Bramati saMsAre mohito mAyayA mama ॥ yaH SfRoti varArohe ! mATuraM mama maRqalam । anyenoccAritaM SaMsan so'pi pApEH pramucyate ॥ pfTivyAM yAni tIrTAni AsamudrasarAMsi ca । maTurAyAM gamizyanti supte cEva janArddane ॥ maTurAM samanuprApya SrAdDaM kftvA yaTAviDi । tfptiM yAntIha pitaro yAvat sTityagrajanmanaH ॥ ye vasanti mahABAge ! maTurAmitare janAH । te'pi yAnti parAM sidDiM matprasAdAnna saMSayaH ॥ kubjAmrake SOkarave maTurAyAM viSezataH । vinA sAMKyena yogena mucyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥ maTurAyAM mahApuryyAM ye vasanti SucivratAH । baliBikzApradAtAro ye vA te naravigrahAH ॥ BavizyAmi varArohe ! dbApare yugasaMsTite । yayAtiBUpavaMSAcca kzattriyaH kulavardDanaH ॥ BavizyAmi varArohe ! maTurAyAM na saMSayaH । mUrttiM caturvviDAM kftvA sTAsyAmi fziBiH stutaH ॥ sTAsyAmi vatsaraSataM yudDezu kftaniScayaH । ekA candanasaNkASA dvitIyA kanakapraBA ॥ aSokasadfSA cAnyA anyA cotpalasanniBA । tatra guhyAni nAmAni Bavizyanti mama priye ! ॥ puRyAni ca pavitrARi saMsArocCedanAni ca । yatrAhaM GAtayizyAmi dbAtriMSati vasunDare ! ॥ dEtyAn GorAn mahABAge ! kaMsAdIn GoradarSanAn । yamunA yatra suvahA nityaM sannihitA Druvam ॥ vEvasvatasvasA ramyA yamunA yatra viSrutA । tAM nadIM yamunAM gaNgAM prayAge saNgaviSrutAm ॥ gaNgASataguRA puRyA maTure mama maRqale । yamunA viSrutA devi ! nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥ tatra tIrTAni guhyAni Bavizyanti mamAnaGe ! । yezu snAnaparo devi ! mama loke mahIyate ॥ aTAtra muYcate prARAn mama karmmaparAyaRaH । na jAyate sa martyezu jAyate ca caturBujaH ॥ avimukte naraH snAto muktiM prApnotyasaMSayam । taTAtra muYcate prARAnmama lokaM sa gacCati । viSrAntisaMjYakaM nAma tIrTaM trElokyaviSrutam । yasmin snAto naro devi ! mama loke mahIyate ॥ sarvvatIrTezu yat snAnaM sarvvatIrTezu yat Palam । tat PalaM laBate devi ! dfzwvA devaM gataSramam ॥ na ca yajYErna tapasA na DyAnErna ca saMyamEH । tat PalaM laBate devi ! snAto viSrAntisaMjYake ॥ kAlatrayantu vasuDe ! yaH paSyati gataSramam । kftvA pradakziRe dve tu vizRulokaM sa gacCati ॥ asti cAnyat paraM guhyaM sarvvasaMsAramokzaRam । yasmin snAto naro devi ! mama loke mahIyate ॥ prayAgaM nAma tIrTantu devAnAmapi durlaBam । tasmin snAto naro devi ! agnizwomaPalaM laBet ॥ indralokaM samAsAdya naro vE tatra modate । aTAtra muYcate prARAn mama lokaM sa gacCati ॥ taTA kanaKalaM tIrTaM nAma guhyaM paraM mama । snAnamAtreRa tatrApi nAkapfzWe sa modate ॥ asti kzetraM paraM guhyaM tindukaM nAma nAmataH । tasmin snAto naro devi ! mama loke mahIyate ॥ asmiMstIrTe purAvfttaM tacCfRuzva vasunDare ! । pAYcAlavizaye devi ! kAmpilyaYca purottamam ॥ DanaDAnyasamAyuktaM brahmadattena pAlitam । tasmiMstu vasate devi ! tinduko nAma nAmataH ॥ tasmiMstu vasatastasya nApitasya purottame । kAlena mahatA tasya kuwumbaH kzayamAgataH ॥ kzIRe kuwumbe tu tadA suBfSaM duHKapIqitaH । sarvvasaNgaparityAgI yo gacCan maTurApurIm । brAhmaRAvasaTe so'pi vasamAno vasunDare ! ॥ tatra karmmaSataM kftvA snAtvEva yamunAM nadIm । tatra dAnaYca kurute nityakAlaM dfQavrataH ॥ tataH kAlena mahatA paYcatvaM samupAgataH । tasya tIrTapraBAveRa jAto'sO brAhmaRottamaH ॥ tasmin varagfhe devi ! brAhmaRo yoginAM varaH । jAtismaro mahAprAjYo vizRuBakto vasunDare ! ॥ tasya tIrTapraBAveRa prAptA muktiH sudurlaBA ॥ tataH paraM sUryyatIrTaM sarvvapApapramocanam । vErocanena balinA sUryyastvArADitaH purA ॥ BrazwarAjyena balinA DanakAmena vE purA । UrdDvabAhurnnirAhArastaptavAnuttamaM tapaH ॥ sAgraM saMvatsaraM devi ! tataH kAmamavApnuyAt । tasya prasanno BagavAn dyumaRiH pratyaBAzata ॥ kiM kAraRaM bale ! brUhi tapasyasi mahattapaH ॥” baliruvAca । “BrazwarAjyo'smi deveSa ! pAtAle nivasAmyaham । vittenApi vihInasya kuwumbaBaraRaM kutaH ॥ mukuwAttasya vE sUryyo dadO cintAmaRiM tataH । cintAmaRiM samAsAdya pAtAlamagamattadA ॥ tasmiMstIrTe naraH snAtvA sarvvapApEH pramucyate । tatrApi muYcate prARAn mama lokaM sa gacCati ॥ Aditye'hani saMkrAntO grahaRe candrasUryyayoH । tasmin snAto naro devi ! rAjasUyaPalaM laBet ॥ yatra DruveRa santaptaM icCayA paramaM tapaH । atra vE snAnamAtreRa Druvaloke mahIyate ॥ tatrApi muYcate prARAn mama loke mahIyate ॥ DruvatIrTe ca vasuDe yaH SrAdDaM kurute naraH । pitFM stArayate sarvvAn pitfpakze viSezataH ॥ dakziRe DruvatIrTasya tIrTarAjaM prakIrttitam । tasmin snAto naro devi ! mama loke mahIyate । tatrATa muYcate prARAnmama lokaM sa gacCati ॥ taddakziRe mahAdevi ! fzitIrTaM paraM mama । tatra snAto naro devi ! fzilokaM prapadyate ॥ aTAtra muYcate prARAnmama loke mahIyate । dakziRe fzitIrTasya mokzatIrTaM paraM mama ॥ snAnamAtreRa vasuDe ! mokzaM prApnoti mAnavaH । tatrATa muYcate prARAn mama loke mahIyate ॥ tatrEva kowitIrTaM hi tIrTAnAmapi durlaBam । tatra snAnena dAnena mama loke mahIyate ॥ kowitIrTe naraH snAtaH santarpya pitfdevatAH । tAritAH pitarastena taTEva prapitAmahAH ॥ kowitIrTe naraH snAto brahmaloke mahIyate । tatrEva vAyutIrTantu pitFRAmapi durlaBam ॥ piRqaM dadyAttu vasuDe ! pitflokaM sa gacCati । gayApiRqapradAnena yat PalaM laBate naraH ॥ tat PalaM laBate devi ! jyEzWe dAnAnna saMSayaH । dvAdaSEtAni tIrTAni devAnAM durlaBAni ca ॥ snAnaM dAnaM japo homaH sahasraguRitaM Bavet । ezAM smaraRamAtreRa sarvvapApEH pramucyate ॥ SrutvA tIrTasya mAhAtmyaM sarvvAn kAmAnavApnuyAt ॥” ityAdi varAhapurARe maTurAtIrTapraBAvaH ॥ * ॥ itaH praBfti saptaviMSADyAyezu maTurAmAhAtmyaM jYeyam ॥

m: मथुरा f. See next.

मथुरा f. N. of various towns (esp. of an ancient town now called Muttra and held in great honour as the birthplace of Kṛṣṇa; situated in the province of Agra on the right bank of the Yamunā or Jumna; described in VP. xii, 1 as having been founded by Śatru-ghna; accord. to Kull. on Mn. ii, 19 it forms part of a district called Brahmarṣi, belonging to Śūra-sena), AV.Pariś.; Hariv.; Pur. &c.
a: मथु(थू)रा — [मथ्-उ-ऊ-रच्] N. of an ancient town situated on the right bank of the Yamunā, the birth-place of Kṛṣṇa and the scene of his amours and exploits; it is one of the seven sacred cities in India (see अवंति), and is, to this day, the favourite resort of thousands of devotees. It is said to have been founded by Śatrughna; निर्ममे निर्ममोर्थेषु मथुरां मधुराकृतिः R. 15. 28; कलिंदकन्या मथुरां गताऽपि गंगोर्मिसंसक्तजलेव भाति 6. 48. --Comp. --ईशः, --नाथः epithets of Kṛṣṇa.
